title: Forecasting Corpus-Sampling Disagreement in Masked Text Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.12987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: If a second text corpus were collected from the same population, how much would a predictor's outputs change? We study this question for masked-text reconstruction using a smoothed predictor built from nearby token-pair counts and evaluated over the full 50,257-token GPT-2 vocabulary. Treating each source document as one observation, we derive a first-order formula for the expected disagreement between predictors fitted to two independent corpora. The formula accounts for variable document length, random context counts, and correlations across token offsets, and it can be evaluated from a separate reference corpus without access to either target corpus. On TinyStories, WikiText-103, and CNN/DailyMail, growing each corpus from 512 to 2,048 chunks of 64 tokens lowers disagreement by only 5--40\%, far short of the 75\% implied by $1/n$ scaling. The forecast tracks this slow decline, which we trace to smoothing of rarely seen contexts. Forec

translated_title: 掩码文本重建中语料库采样分歧的预测
translated_abstract: 如果从同一总体中再次收集一个文本语料库，预测器的输出会发生多大变化？我们针对掩码文本重建任务研究了这一问题，使用了一种由邻近词对计数构建的平滑预测器，并在完整的50,257词元的GPT-2词表上进行评估。将每个源文档视为一个观测值，我们推导出了拟合于两个独立语料库的预测器之间期望分歧的一阶公式。该公式考虑了可变的文档长度、随机上下文计数以及跨词元偏移的相关性，并且可以在不访问任何目标语料库的情况下，仅凭一个单独的参考语料库进行计算。在TinyStories、WikiText-103和CNN/DailyMail数据集上，将每个语料库从512个块扩展到2,048个块（每块64个词元）仅使分歧降低了5–40%，远低于1/n缩放律所隐含的75%。该预测准确地追踪了这种缓慢的下降趋势，我们将其归因于对罕见上下文的平滑处理。
tldr: 该论文推导出一个一阶公式，可仅凭参考语料库预测两个独立语料库上训练的掩码文本重建预测器之间的期望分歧，并发现语料库扩大四倍仅使分歧降低5–40%，远低于1/n缩放律的预期，其根源在于罕见上下文的平滑效应。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a first-order formula that forecasts the expected disagreement between masked-text reconstruction predictors fitted to two independent corpora using only a separate reference corpus, showing that quadrupling corpus size reduces disagreement by only 5–40%—far below the 75% implied by 1/n scaling—due to smoothing of rarely seen contexts.
